{{Quote|A hotfoot chase through the calderas of Magmar will go wrong unless you're carrying a narrow-band spectral filter and a composite armor suit that's been furnace-tested to 1,700 degrees.|Chentu Chek, ''Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
A '''narrow-band spectral filter''' was a device that [[Armory Master]] [[Chentu Chek]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] deemed critical for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] operating on the celestial body [[Magmar]] to be equipped with.<ref name="BHC" />
